{{Quote|Perhaps, things won't be so bad after all. But for now at least, mother, I guess you could say we're having a wonderful time, but I'm so glad you're not here.|Extract from a personal communication: [[Thalis Denirid]], immigrant to Bridin Anchorage|<ref name="GG11" />}}
'''Bridin Anchorage''', originally called '''Gallienis IV''', was once a lush, tourist [[Planet/Legends|world]] in the [[Portmoak sector/Legends|Portmoak sector]]. It was renamed [[Quarlo Bridin]], a disgraced politician who took over the world shortly after [[Mitth'raw'nuruodo/Legends|Thrawn's]] death. Once his planet's immediate safety was secured, Bridin used his [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] friends to coerce the passage of a battery of ordinances making a variety of formerly criminal operations legal. This, in turn, resulted in a flood of criminal enterprises to the planet, including [[Manliss Enterprise]].
{{Planet-stub}}

==Description==
Bridin Anchorage, or Gallienis IV, was a terrestrial [[Planet/Legends|planet]]<ref name="GG11" /> located in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]] within the [[Portmoak sector/Legends|Portmoak sector]].<ref name="GG11" /><ref name="EAOC" /> By all accounts, this world was pleasant, rich in [[Mineral/Legends|mineral]] deposits, and famous for its hundreds of [[Kilometer/Legends|kilometers]] of picturesque beaches.<ref name="GG11" />

==History==
{{Quote|Residents of the Over the Rile section of town awoke to the sounds of blaster fire this morning. Local militia officers discovered the bodies of 14 beings beings in an abandoned warehouse three blocks from the Bridis City reservoir. All persons died from multiple blaster wounds.|Excerpt from the Early Evening Edition – Bridis City Limited Copy, «Bridis Evening Dispatcher», Vol. 9, Issue 327|<ref name="GG11" />}}

==Inhabitants==
{{Quote|Nowhere else in the galaxy have I met a ruder, I dare say cruder, bunch of people. It's not that they are simply impolite. One quickly gets the impression that a Brindite's goal in life is to fashion the perfect insult!|Extract from a personal communication: Thalis Denirid, immigrant to Bridin Anchorage|<ref name="GG11" />}}

==Locations==
{{Quote|Well, Jondrix starts his new job as a droid tech at the Brandis Tech Institute tomorrow. We're thinking of getting a place in the country once he's settled in.|Extract from a personal communication: Thalis Denirid, immigrant to Bridin Anchorage|<ref name="GG11" />}}

==Behind the scenes==
Bridin Anchorage was mentioned in the [[1994]] sourcebook ''[[Galaxy Guide 11: Criminal Organizations]]'', written by [[Rick D. Stuart]] for use with [[West End Games]]' ''[[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game]]''.<ref name="GG11" /> The [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' placed the [[Gallienis system|Bridin Anchorage system]], and therefore Bridin Anchorage itself, in grid square P-18.<ref name="EAOC" />

In the sourcebook, the planet was referred to as «Brindin Anchorage» once, but it is unknown whether this was a misprint or an alternate version of the name.<ref name="GG11" />
